theorem lg_target {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x := by
  have h_log_pos : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < √x := by rw [Real.log_sqrt]; exact Real.log_pos (lt_trans (le_of_lt hx) (lt_rfl))
  have h_log_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.log √x := Real.log_pos (by rw [Real.log_sqrt]; exact Real.log_pos (lt_trans (le_of_lt hx) (lt_rfl)))
  have h_log_4_pos : 0 < Real.log 4 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h_mul_log_pos : 0 < x * Real.log x := Real.mul_log_pos hx
  have h_div_eq_mul_inv : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x = Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x⁻¹ := by rw [Real.div_eq_mul_inv]
  have h_log_inv : Real.log √x⁻¹ = -Real.log √x := by rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_sqrt, Real.log_neg]
  have h_log_4_div_log_sqrt_x : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x = -Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x := by rw [h_div_eq_mul_inv, h_log_inv]
  have h_right_side : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x = √x - Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x := by rw [h_log_4_div_log_sqrt_x, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h_bound : Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x ≤ √x := by {
    have h_log_sqrt_le_sqrt_x_minus_1 : Real.log √x ≤ √x - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by rw [Real.log_sqrt]; exact Real.log_pos (lt_trans (le_of_lt hx) (lt_rfl)))
    rw [mul_le_mul_left] at h_log_sqrt_le_sqrt_x_minus_1
    exact h_log_sqrt_le_sqrt_x_minus_1
  }
  have h_final : √x - Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x ≥ 0 := by {
    have h_sqrt_ge_0 : √x ≥ 0 := by norm_num
    have h_real_log_4_x_log_sqrt_x_le_sqrt_x : Real.log 4 * x * Real.log √x ≤ √x := h_bound
    exact le_sub_iff_add_nonneg.2 h_real_log_4_x_log_sqrt_x_le_sqrt_x
  }
  exact le_trans (le_add_right h_final) (le_refl _)
